chapter: Ben Webster and Jim and Andy's
title: Andy the cat, Rocky and lending money
summary: Hinton explains Andy was a cat; musicians had tabs and the bar was trusted.

blocks.x: MR. KOULOVARIS (PHONETIC) was his last name.
Well, you know, we should mention, Jim
He wanted to incorporate his bar so he named it Jim and Andy's, and Andy was the cat. And the resident bartender, of course, was Rocky.
I still see Rocky. He works at Condon's.
They were wonderful to musicians. I don't know how much money they must have lost, but they would lend money to
I don't think he lost money, because it kept being a place where a musician was just so grateful.
Yeah, I never heard of him losing any, but you know it must have happened.
I sure lots of guys didn't pay. But most of the guys did.

Well, you know, sometimes I would forget to pay and they would say, you know, you owe $50, $60.00. I would never question them. I'd say, I'm sorry, here, you know. I never argued with them because I've never known them to do anything dishonest.
